mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate over two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing corporate earnings and consumer demand, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue and profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of falling RSAFS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and stronger corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of rising INDPRO (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in CPI inflation over two months signals a disinflationary tightening cycle, which reduces discount rates and preserves earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.25pp AND CPIAUCSL falls >0.2% in 2 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of disinflationary tightening (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.
